description: Implementation of ObliviousHttpRequest class handling request creation, encapsulation, decapsulation, and serialization for oblivious HTTP requests within the quiche project.

classes.name: ObliviousHttpRequest::Context
classes.description: Holds context information for an oblivious HTTP request, including HPKE context and encapsulated key.

classes.name: ObliviousHttpRequest
classes.description: Represents an oblivious HTTP request, providing methods for creation, encapsulation, serialization, and access to plaintext.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpRequest::CreateServerObliviousRequest
methods.description: Creates an oblivious HTTP request on the server side by decapsulating encrypted data.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpRequest::CreateClientObliviousRequest
methods.description: Creates an oblivious HTTP request on the client side by encapsulating plaintext payload.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpRequest::CreateClientWithSeedForTesting
methods.description: Creates a client-side oblivious HTTP request with a seed for testing purposes.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpRequest::EncapsulateWithSeed
methods.description: Encapsulates plaintext payload with optional seed, producing an oblivious HTTP request.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpRequest::EncapsulateAndSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the request into a string suitable for transmission.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpRequest::GetPlaintextData
methods.description: Returns the plaintext data associated with the request.
